If a ny conflict or doubt arises as to the meaning or requirement of a ny provision under this Order the text in the M alay language shall prevail. Saving of prerogative.
Nothing contained herein shall derogate from or affect the prerogative rights and powers of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan as the Head of the Religion of Brunei Darussalam. Application.
This Order shall apply to all persons whether or not professing the lslamic religion. Exclusive jurisdiction of Syariah Courts.

For the avoidance of doubt, it is hereby declared that no court, other than a court established under Part II of the Syariah Courts Act (Chapter 184L shall hear or determine a ny claims or proceedings under the jurisdiction of the Syari ah Courts. Appointment of licensing officer. ( ) Th e Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the SuItan and Yang

l'lvfinisterlt means the Minister responsible for finance; pawnbrokerlf means a ny person who, under a valid licence, carries on the business Of receiving articles from pawners as security and grants them loans under the provisions of this Order; pawner't means a person who delivers an article to a pawnbroker as security for getting loan thereon. ( 2 ) AII words and expressions used in this Order and not defined therein but defined in the lnterpretation and GeneraI CIauses Act (Chapter 4), shall have 1363

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE the same meanings respectively assigned thereto in that Act to the extent that they do not conflict with H Syara · ( 3 ) If any conflict or doubt arises when interpreting a ny word or expression relating to H m Syara ' , it shall be the discretion of the Syariah Courts to decide the meaning Of such word or expresslon. Text in Malay language shall prevail.

( ) Any person may, on payment of an application fe e of $ loo , apply to the licensmg officer fo r a licence under this Order. 1364 28th. NOVEMBER, 2002 ( 2 } The licensing officer may grant a licence on such conditions and terms as he thinks fit to carry on the business of a pawnbroker. Licences shall be granted annually and a fee of $ 1 ooo shall be charged fo r every licence. An appeal shall lie to the Minister from the decision of the licensing officer under this section. NO person to carry on business of pawnbroker without licence.

No person shall carry on the business of a pawnbroker unless he is the holder of a licence. Revocation Of licence. lo. 〔 1 ) The licensing officer may revoke any licence without giving a reason, but such revocation shall not effect the obligations and liabilities of the pawnbroker under this Order prior to the revocation. ( 2 〕 Where a revocation has been made, the licensee shall cease to carry on the business of a pawnbroker. 罔 Subsection 罔 shall not prejudice the enforcement by a ny person of any right or claim against or by the pawnbroker of any right or claim against a ny person arising out of or concerning any matter or thing done prior to the revocation Of the licence. 〖 4 ) An appeal shall lie to the Minister from the decision of the licensing officer under this section. Pawn agreement. ll. Any pawnbroker who receives a valuable article from a pawner by w ay of security and grants him a sum of money as a loan ensuring the repayment of the loan or any part thereof from such article and undertakes to transfer such article to the pawner on the repayment of the loan and other dues shall be deemed to have made an agreement of pawn under this Order. Pawnbroker to give pawn-ticket.

A pawnbroker shall on taking an article in pawn give to the pawner a pawnticket, and shall not take an article in pawn unless the pawner takes the pawnticket as set out in Form 1 in the Second ScheduIe. 1365

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Amount of loan and redemption period.

The amount of the loan shall not exceed $ 5 , ooo in respect of any one article and shall be redeemable within a period of one year from the d ay of pawning, either in a lump sum or by instalments. Record of pawn agreements.
The pawnbroker shall ke ep proper record of all agreements relating to the articles pawned with him under this Order. General obligations of pawnbroker.

Every pawnbroker shall (a ) before taking any articles in pawn , enter clearly and legibly in a book to be kept and signed by him in the form as set out in Form 2 in the Second ScheduIe; (b ) obtain the signature of the pawner, the owner ( if any) and the surety ()f any) against the particulars entered under paragraph (a ) ; (c ) on demand by a ny police officer at any time produce for examination all books kept by him for the purposes of his business. Safe-keeping of article pawned.

The pawnbroker shall keep the article pawned in such manner that it shall not be diminished in value by or through his neglect, default or wilful misbehaviour. Pawnbroker premises to be conspicuously marked.

Every pawnbroker shall keep affixe d in a conspicuous place in his premises a board bearing the words "Licensed PawnbrokerT' in the Malay and English languages. Administrative expenses and fees for safe-keeping. ( ) The pawnbroker mayj in addition to the amount Of the loan, receive from the pawner at the rat e s specified in the First Schedule as administrative expenses and as a fe e incurred in respect Of the safe-keeping Of the article pawned and the matters related theretot and shall give the pawner a receipt of payment therefor. 1366 28th. NOVEMBER, 2002 { 2 , Eve ry pawnbroker shall keep affixed in a conspicuous place in his premisese a legible COPY in the Malay and English languages of the rates of the administrative expenses and the fees fo r safe-keeping that he m ay lawfully recelve under this Order. Responsibilities of pawnbroker.

( ) No pawnbroker shall — (a ) take any article in pawn from any person who appears to be intoxicated or incapable ; (b ) purchase or take in pawn or exchange a pawn-ticket issued by another pawnbroker, (c ) suffer any article while in pawn with hi;n to be redeemed with the intention of his purchasing it; (d ) make any agreement with any person pawning or offering to pawn a ny article or with the owner thereof for the purchase, sale or disposition thereof within the time of redemption; (e ) sell, pawn or otherwise dispose of a ny article pawned with him exc ept at such time and in such manner as authorised by this Order; or ( under any pretence, purchase ( exc ept at auction) any article while in pawn with him. ( 2 } ln this section, "incapable" includes any child who has not attained the age of balighl a ny person who is insane or mentally ill and a ny person who is forbidden to handle his ow n property in accordance with H m 卸 a . Articles offered for pawn in suspicious Circumstances.

If a ny person in suspicious Circumstances offers any article in pawn to a pawnbroker or if any person without having a valid pawn-ticket attempts to redeem a pledge and the pawnbroker has reason to suspect such attemptf it shall be the duty of such pawnbroker to make reasonable inquiries concerning the person and such articles or pawn-ticket , and such pawnbroker shall thereupon report the matter to the police. 1367

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Liabilities of pawnbroker. The pawnbroker shall not be liable for the lost or damage caused to the article pawned unless caused by his neglectf default or wilful behaviour. 罔 The pawnbroker shall be liable fo r the loss or damage caused to the article pawned due to his neglect, default or wilful misbehaviour, and the pawner has the right to claim the amount of loss from the pawnbroker by deducting it from the amount of the loan and other dues liable to be paid by the pawner under this Order. The pawnbroker shall return the article pawned to the pawner as soon as he receives the amount of the loan and other dues under this Order. Application to executors etc. of pawnbrokers.

The provisions of this Order relating to pawnbrokers shall extend to and include the executors or administrators of a deceased pawnbrokerr exc ept that an executor or administrator of his estate shall not be personally liable for a ny penalty or forfeiture, unless it was due to his neglect, default or wilful misbehaviour. Profits and benefits.
The pawner is entitled to the profits and benefits derived from the article pawned. Prohibition on disposal or retaking article pawned.

田 The pawner shall not be entitled to sell or give aw ay the article pawned or retake it or make it waqaf am or waqaf khas before the repayment of the amount of loan and other dues liable under this Order. 〔 2 ) ln this section waqaf means a dedication in perpetuity Of the capital or income of property for religious or charitable purpose recognised by H m Syara , and the property so dedicated; lwaqaf khas" means a dedication in perpetuity of the capital of property for religious or charitable purposes recognised by H 磊 m 卸 a ' , and the property so dedicatedf the income of the property being paid to persons or fo r purposes prescribed in the waqaf. 1368 28th. NOVEMBER, 2002 Extension Of rights, powers and benefits.

The rightsj powers and benefits conferred by this Order on a pawner shall be deemed to be conferred on the assignee Of a pawner and on the executors an d administrators Of a deceased pawner: Provided that a ny such person shall produce to the pawnbroker the assignmentt probate or letters of administration Of the estate , or other instrument under which he SO claims. Loss of pawn-ticket.

Any person claiming to be the owner of a pawned article who is unable to produce the pawn-ticket may make an affirmation and thereupon such person shall have as between himself and th e pawnbroker the same rights and remedies as if he produced the pawn-ticket · FaiIure to repay loan. 国 Subject to subsection (2), if the pawner fails to repay the loan after th e expiry Of 6 months from the period Of one ye ar mentioned in section 13 , the pawnbroker shall, with the approval of the Court, sell or auction the article pawned , on giving the pawner and the public reasonable notice of the sale or auction, or shall dispose Of it in such other manner and upon such conditions as the court may approve · ( 2 ) If the proceeds of the sale or auction referred to in subsection (1), are less than the amount due to the pawner, the pawner is still liable to pay the balance. If the proceeds Of the sale or auction are greater than the amount SO due, the pawnbroker shall pay ove r surplus to the pawner subject to subsection of section 18 · 〖 3 ) ln this section, "Court'j means the Syariah Subordinate Courts, the Syariah High Court or the Syariah Appeal Court, as the case may be, established under subsection of section 6 of th e Syariah Courts Act (Chapter 184 ) · Auctions in respect Of unredeemed articles. ( ) Auctions in respect of unredeemed articles shall be held not less than 4

times in each year at a place and on a date to be fixed by the Minister or any person authorised by him in writing. ( 2 ) Every pawnbroker shallf at least 7 days before such auction, post in a conspicuous place or advertise in a newspaper circulating in Brunei Darussalam a list Of pawned articles which it is intended to auction, and such articles shall be 1369

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE publicly exhibited fo r at least 3 days before the auction at a police station or other place appointed by the Minister or a ny person authorised by him in writing. 《 3 ) Every pawnbroker shall, within 7 days of the date of such auction, send a statement showing the results Of such auction to the Commissioner Of Police, who shall cause the statement to be displayed in a place easily accessible to the public. ( 4 ) Every pawnbroker shall maintain a book of unredeemed articles, which shall be as set out in Form 3 in the Second Schedule. Police to give information to pawnbrokers as to stolen property.

( 〕 lnformation as to property lost, stolen or otherwise fraudulently disposed of shall be given by the Commissioner of Police as soon as possible after such loss or fraud, to all pawnbrokers with lists and descriptions of the same. 〔 2 〕 If a ny property answering to such lists and descriptions is in the possesslon Of any pawnbroker or is thereafter offered or shown to a ny pawnbroker, he shall forthwith give information to that effect to the nearest police station or to a ny police officer together with the name and address Of the person in whose possesslon such property was last seen. Power of searh.

Any police officer may enter any pawnbrokerf s business place at a ny time during business hours and m ay search without warrant the house or business place or premises Of such pawnbroker fo r a ny articles that he m ay have reason to suspect to be therein and to have been dishonestly obtained or dishonestly placed there, and to search fo r and examine the books Of the pawnbroker and to take extracts and copies therefrom. PenaIty. ( 〕 Any pawnbroker or pawner who wilfully give s false information, makes any fraudulent statement in any matter relating to the agreement of pawn or contravenes any of the provisions of this Order shall be guilty of an offence. 罔 A ny pawnbroker who, contrary to this Order or a ny rules made hereunder 回 does a ny act or thing which he is forbidden to do; or fails to do a ny act or thing which he is directed to dot 1370 28th. NOVEMBERJ 2002 shall be guilty of an offence. 图 Any person guilty of an offence under subsection ( 1 ) or ( 2 ) is liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $ lo , ooo and to imprisonment fo r a term not exceeding 3 years. Hukum a ' shall apply if no other provision.
